content: {"summary":"On 13 August 2026, both card‑processor‑proxy pods logged CPX‑W430 in the same minute while PAYAPI‑E1107 counts rose, indicating traffic above the combined 360 RPS local‑limiter budget after one proxy instance was missing, causing rejected attempts and payments that exhausted all three retries.","likely_cause":"A missing proxy instance left a single proxy handling all traffic, exceeding its 180 RPS token bucket and generating payment failures.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"CPX‑W430 from both proxies signals genuine traffic above 360 RPS.","evidence_ids":["RB-029#4"],"quote":"`CPX-W430` from both | Genuine traffic above 360"},{"text":"CPX‑W430 is logged when a request is rejected by the local limiter after waiting.","evidence_ids":["RB-029#1"],"quote":"A rejected attempt logs `CPX-W430` and never reaches the processor."},{"text":"PAYAPI‑E1107 indicates a payment that exhausted all three attempts.","evidence_ids":["RB-029#4"],"quote":"`PAYAPI-E1107` | A payment used all 3 attempts"},{"text":"One proxy instance was missing, leaving only a single proxy to handle all traffic.","evidence_ids":["RB-029#7"],"quote":"If one egress node is cordoned or down, the other already holds a proxy"},{"text":"The rise in PAYAPI‑E1107 matches the excess traffic over the 360 RPS budget, confirming overload.","evidence_ids":["RB-029#5"],"quote":"Failed payments: 240 × 0.25 = 60 per second of `PAYAPI-E1107`, exactly the excess over budget"}],"next_checks":["Verify the status of both card‑processor‑proxy pods and confirm which instance is Pending","Inspect node health and anti‑affinity/taint reasons for the missing pod","Check token‑bucket metrics to see if the limiter is saturated","Consider restarting or scaling the missing proxy instance","Monitor CPX‑W430 and PAYAPI‑E1107 rates after remediation"]}
